findings.summary: mean([]) returns 0.0 instead of raising, so empty input looks like a real mean of 0.
findings.evidence: mean([]) returns 0.0; a caller cannot tell an empty week from a week whose values average 0.

decide.reason: 0.0 for an empty list is intended: the weekly report shows it as no data.
decide.reopen_if: a caller needs to tell empty input from a real mean of 0
